run_inference_eval: run the NWM diffusion model inference evaluation on datasets using argparse CLI with rollout or time mode
run_rollout_generation: run rollout-based image prediction generation at specified FPS values using the model forward wrapper
run_time_generation: run time-based image prediction generation at exponential second intervals using the model forward wrapper
run_model_forward: run the model forward pass with VAE encoding, diffusion sampling, and VAE decoding in bfloat16
run_save_image: run image saving from a PyTorch tensor to a PNG file with optional unnormalization
